title: Keep less terminal scrollback once a heap snapshot shows it dominates
notes:
From the Rust review (/tmp/rust-review.md section 4). The window renderer held 569 MB private after 21 h. Every pane gets scrollback: PANE_SCROLLBACK (src/renderer/app/page.ts:370), PANE_SCROLLBACK = 10000 (src/renderer/panes/pane.ts:34); xterm keeps 12 bytes a cell, so a full 200-column pane is about 24 MB and twenty about 480 MB. That is arithmetic, not measured.

Do: first measure the real split with measure.mjs memory on the demo (a heap snapshot). If scrollback dominates, lower it for worker panes (for example 5,000 lines) or trim hidden and folded panes; leave main's own pane as is unless the numbers say otherwise. Record the before/after in docs/performance/history.md. If scrollback does not dominate, comment the real split on this card and cancel it.

comments.body: Pull request #403 opened: Give a worker 5000 lines of scrollback, half of main's https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/403

Review loop ran 2 rounds and stopped at the low floor. Round 1 fixed 3 findings: main is a chat view with no terminal, so the docs and comments now say the editor keeps 10000 lines and the MAIN_INDEX test case is gone. Round 2 rewrapped the history lines (nit). The final check accepted 66cd61ea. The design is unchanged: workers get 5000 lines, the editor keeps 10000. CI on 66cd61ea: checks, windows and both Analyze jobs pass. The CodeQL gate fails on one alert, 'unvalidated dynamic method call' at scripts/performance/demo-instance.mjs:30. It is a false positive: listeners is a Map that only holds handlers the script registered. Still open: someone has to dismiss that alert in code scanning. After that it is ready to merge.

bddd3931 makes scripts/performance/demo-instance.mjs:30 check that the listener is a function before calling it, which clears the CodeQL alert. Every check passed on bddd3931, the CodeQL gate included. Converged, ready to merge.

Merged origin/main as 37e0ef80. The one conflict, in docs/performance/README.md, keeps both the scrollback row and #401's usage-sweep row. pnpm check passed and every CI check passed on 37e0ef80. Converged, ready to merge.
